problemText.cycle: These tasks depend on each other in a loop: {{path}}.
problemText.taskGroupCycle: These task groups depend on each other in a cycle: {{members}}. A dependency into or out of any task of a group counts for the whole group. Airflow 3.4 warns about this and Airflow 3.5 is planned to reject the DAG: move tasks between groups so that each group depends on the others in one direction only.
problemText.dates: The end date must be after the start date.
problemText.selfLoop: A task cannot depend on itself.
problemText.noteEdge: Notes cannot be connected to tasks.
problemText.xcomSelf: A task cannot use its own output.
problemText.xcomUnknown: Uses the output of “{{id}}”, which does not exist.
problemText.branch: A branch task needs at least one task after it.
problemText.loopEmpty: A loop group needs at least one task.
problemText.pythonDisabled: Python code is disabled on this server.
problemText.secret: “{{name}}” looks like a hard-coded secret: use an Airflow connection or variable.
problemText.patternCron: A cron expression has 5 fields: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week (e.g. 0 6 * * 1-5).
problemText.patternDotted: Use a dotted Python path, e.g. requests.exceptions.Timeout.
problemText.pattern: The value has an invalid format.
problemText.extraField: This field is not allowed here.
problemText.templateType: The task type is locked by operator template {{template}}.
problemText.templateMissing: Operator template “{{id}}” no longer exists: its locked values are not enforced.
problemText.templateUpdated: Operator template {{template}} has a newer version than this task (v{{version}}).
problemText.rawPythonDisabled: Raw code DAGs are Python: Python code must be allowed on this server (allow_python_code).
problemText.rawSecret: This line assigns what looks like a hard-coded secret: DAG files are readable by anyone with access to the repository. Read it from a Connection or a Variable instead.
problemText.rawDagId: The code does not define a DAG with dag_id '{{id}}' (found: {{found}}): the dag_id in the code must match the document's.
problemText.rawPrivileged: {{name}} runs arbitrary commands and is disabled by policy (allow_privileged_operators).
problemText.importServiceClosed: The import check service is unavailable ({{reason}}). Deploys are blocked until it answers again; ask an administrator to check the validator service.
problemText.importServiceOpen: The import check service is unavailable ({{reason}}). The DAG was not imported with Airflow, so import errors are not detected.
problemText.rawImportMissing: Airflow imported the file but found no DAG '{{id}}' (found: {{found}}).
problemText.dagIdTeamPrefix: The dag_id must start with the team prefix '{{prefix}}'.
problemText.dagIdPattern: The dag_id must match the pattern '{{pattern}}'.
problemText.blueprintUnknown: Blueprint “{{name}}” v{{version}} is not in the blueprint catalog: install its package in AutoAir's environment or configure blueprints.template_dirs.
problemText.blueprintRuntime: The Airflow environment needs airflow-blueprint and the module “{{module}}” to parse this DAG.
problemText.blueprintOutputMode: Blueprint steps cannot be expressed in YAML Dags: use the python or loader output mode.
problemText.blueprintLoop: Blueprint steps cannot be placed in a loop group.
problemText.blueprintPlainJson: Blueprint config values must be plain JSON (no XCom references, timedeltas or other tagged values).
problemText.blueprintOutdated: A newer version of “{{name}}” is available.
problemText.xcomBlueprint: XCom must reference a task, not a blueprint step.
problemText.blueprintDisabled: Blueprint steps are switched off on this server (features.blueprints).

source.noDiff: No changes to the DAG file.
source.diffTruncated: The diff is cut here; the full file is written on deploy.
source.notApplicable: The source policy does not apply here: loader and YAML files are always generated, raw code DAGs are deployed as written.

action.generate: The DAG file is generated from the spec.
action.preserve: Your change is patched into the existing file; the rest of it stays as written.
action.unchanged: The existing file already matches: it is written as it is.
action.blocked: Stopped: the existing DAG file is not replaced without your choice.
action.refused: Stopped: this change cannot be applied to the existing file.
action.not_applicable: The source policy does not apply to this DAG.

state.ejected: {{file}} was changed outside AutoAir since the last deploy.
state.foreign: {{file}} is a hand-written file AutoAir did not create.
state.hand_written: {{file}} is the hand-written file AutoAir keeps for this DAG.

source.blockedTitle: The existing DAG file is not replaced
source.blockedHelp: Regenerating the file would discard what it contains. Apply your change to the file instead (comments and formatting are kept), or keep the file as a raw code DAG.
source.refusedTitle: This change cannot be applied to the existing file
source.refusedHelp: AutoAir edits hand-written files only where it can apply exactly your change, and never regenerates them on its own. Keep the file as a raw code DAG, or switch the DAG to generated code deliberately.
source.confirmOverwrite: I understand: the changes made outside AutoAir are discarded.
source.preservePreview: What applying your change would write
source.deployedWithWarnings: Deployed with notes on the DAG file
source.contentHidden: The file in the deploy target is a hand-written file AutoAir did not write: its content is not shown.

blockedAction.hand_written: Stopped: generating code would replace the hand-written file AutoAir keeps for this DAG.
blockedAction.ejected: Stopped: the DAG file was changed outside AutoAir.
blockedAction.foreign: Stopped: the DAG file is a hand-written file AutoAir did not create.

source.overwritePermission: Replacing it with generated code needs the permission deploy:overwrite_ejected.
source.overwriteOff: Replacing it with generated code is turned off here (preserve.allow_force_overwrite): apply changes with preserve or keep the DAG as raw code.

blockedTitleBy.hand_written: Generating code would replace the hand-written DAG file
blockedTitleBy.ejected: The DAG file was changed outside AutoAir
blockedTitleBy.foreign: The DAG file was not created by AutoAir

blockedHelpBy.hand_written: AutoAir keeps this DAG's hand-written file and never regenerates it on its own. Apply your change to the file instead (comments and formatting are kept), or keep the file as a raw code DAG.
blockedHelpBy.ejected: Regenerating the file would discard those changes. Apply your change to the file instead (comments and formatting are kept), or keep the file as a raw code DAG.
blockedHelpBy.foreign: AutoAir never overwrites a hand-written file it did not create. Apply your change to the file instead (comments and formatting are kept), or keep the file as a raw code DAG.

source.confirmOverwriteHandWritten: I understand: the hand-written file is replaced by generated code.
source.policyDraftNote: Changes the DAG's source policy when you deploy (undoable). Cancel keeps the current policy.
